rulings.question_text: What is the corrected text for OP13-077 Go All the Way to the Top!! per the official OP-13 apology notice?
rulings.ruling_text: Per Bandai official topic notice (October 24, 2025): the revision shall be treated as correct — Before: gains +3000 power during this turn. After: gains +3000 power during this battle. Corrected cards may be distributed at official or authorized events as described on the notice.
rulings.normalized_summary: OP13-077 errata: +3000 power applies during this battle, not this turn.

rulings.question_text: What is the corrected text for OP15-023 Arlong per the official OP15-EB04 apology notice?
rulings.ruling_text: Per Bandai official topic notice (March 13, 2026): Before: Give up to 1 rested DON!! card from its owner's cost area to its owner's Leader or 1 of their Characters. After: Give up to 1 DON!! card from its owner's cost area to its owner’s Leader or 1 of their Characters. Note: the same also applies to alt-art cards.
rulings.normalized_summary: OP15-023 errata: DON!! given may be active or rested; wording corrected on official notice.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: corrected Leader text for OP07-097 Vegapunk (May 16, 2025).
rulings.ruling_text: This Leader cannot attack.[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards: Select up to 1 {Egghead} type card with a cost of 5 or less from your hand and play it or add it to the top of your Life cards face-up.
rulings.normalized_summary: OP07-097 official errata text per Errata Cards page.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: corrected [Main] for OP09-058 Special Muggy Ball.
rulings.ruling_text: [Main] Your opponent chooses 1 of their Character with a cost of 6 or less and return to the owner's hand.
rulings.normalized_summary: OP09-058 opponent chooses return target per errata page.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: OP06-034 Hyouzou trait correction.
rulings.ruling_text: Trait line corrected from Fish-Man to Merfolk per official errata list.
rulings.normalized_summary: Hyouzou trait Merfolk per December 6, 2024 errata.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: ST14-014 Gum-Gum Giant Rifle Counter/Trigger wording.
rulings.ruling_text: [Counter] If there is a Character with a cost of 8 or more, up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this battle.[Trigger] Add up to 1 of your Character cards with a cost of 2 or less from your trash to your hand.
rulings.normalized_summary: ST14-014 If there is / Add up to 1 wording per errata.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: OP05-032 Pica [Once Per Turn] rest cost wording.
rulings.ruling_text: [End of Your Turn] ①: Set this Character as active.[Once Per Turn] If this Character would be K.O.'d, you may rest 1 of your Characters with a cost of 3 or more other than [Pica] instead.
rulings.normalized_summary: Pica errata: rest 1 Character (not up to 1) per official list.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: OP03-054 Usopp's Rubber Band of Doom!!! Trigger wording.
rulings.ruling_text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, you may trash 1 card from the top of your deck. [Trigger] Draw 1 card and you may trash 1 card from the top of your deck.
rulings.normalized_summary: Trigger: Draw 1 then optional trash per errata.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: OP03-047 Zeff [On Play] return optional wording.
rulings.ruling_text: [DON!! x1] When this Character's attack deals damage to your opponent's Life, you may trash 7 cards from the top of your deck. [On Play] Return up to 1 Character with a cost of 3 or less to the owner's hand, and you may trash 2 cards from the top of your deck.
rulings.normalized_summary: Zeff On Play return optional per errata.

rulings.question_text: Official errata: OP02-071 Magellan DON!! return scope wording.
rulings.ruling_text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on the field is returned to your DON!! deck, this Leader gains +1000 power during this turn.
rulings.normalized_summary: Magellan: any DON!! on field returned triggers per errata.
